text:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning a regionwise rollout for redwood-v2.1.0 starting in 15m. Order: US -> EU -> APAC. Canary 5% each slice, then ramp if green. Pinning traffic for 10m after each region go-live.

raj: Got it. I'll run a final capacity sweep and thermal check. Posting numbers in 5.

ops-sre: Running warm-pool headroom query now. If any region <60% free GPUs we hold. Also watch queue depth.

kevin: Reminder: release has tokenizer fix + KV cache gating. No schema changes. Metrics to watch: tail latency p95, `cache_miss_rate`, error_rate (500s).

deploy-bot: :rocket: Scheduled rollout created by maria. Release=redwood-v2.1.0 Regions=[us,eu,apac] Canary=5% PinWindow=10m. Use `/deploy status 1738765432` to follow.

raj: Capacity sweep results: ```text
US: GPUs free 124/160 (77%)
EU: GPUs free 70/90 (77%)
APAC: GPUs free 22/40 (55%)
Queues: US=low, EU=low, APAC=moderate
Thermal: no hotspots reported
```

sara: APAC looks tight. Recommend warming additional warm pool (2 nodes) before APAC slice. Can we bump warmpool in APAC now? @ops-sre

ops-sre: Triggering warm-pool up for APAC +2 nodes. ETA ~6m. If APAC doesn't reach >=65% free after warmup, we should defer APAC rollout and only pin US/EU.

alex: Suggest we change APAC canary to 2% instead of 5% if warmup not ready. Less surface while still validating.

maria: Agreed. Plan: proceed with US (5%), monitor 10m pin, then EU (5%). Hold APAC until warmup completes or switch to 2% canary. I'll kick the deploybot once warm-pool confirms.

deploy-bot: Confirming deploy prechecks...

deploy-bot: Precheck results: ```text
- US: pass (latency SLO available)
- EU: pass
- APAC: fail (free GPUs 55% < threshold 60%)
```

maria: OK starting US canary now. `/deploy start --release redwood-v2.1.0 --region us --canary 0.05 --pin 10m`

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: US canary started (slice id: s-112). Observability links: https://console/redwood/obs/s-112

kevin: Watching logs. No 500s so far. p95 is +10ms but within expected. cache_miss_rate steady.

raj: US CPU/GPU and queue stable. Throughput +3% as expected.

maria: US pin reached 10m and looks green. Proceeding to EU. `/deploy start --release redwood-v2.1.0 --region eu --canary 0.05 --pin 10m`

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: EU canary started (slice id: s-113).

ops-sre: EU metrics green. No thermal events.

kevin: EU p95 and errors fine. Rolling EU to full ramp per plan.

maria: EU ramping to 100% for service (staged) — monitoring 15m. APAC still warmup in progress.

deploy-bot: APAC warm-pool +2 nodes completed. New free GPUs: 30/44 (68%).

sara: Nice. APAC now >=65% — switching canary to 5% per original plan.

alex: Quick safety: set rollback trigger if error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m or p95 latency > 2x baseline for 3m.

maria: Ack. Updated rollout config with rollback thresholds. `/deploy update 1738765432 --rollback-error 0.5 --rollback-latency-mult 2 --rollback-window 300`

deploy-bot: Config updated. Starting APAC canary (5%).

deploy-bot: :warning: APAC canary slice s-114 shows spike: error_rate 0.8% at +2m.

kevin: Seeing it in logs — `kv_cache_miss` spike correlating with a specific path: `/api/v1/structured/annotate` - stacktrace points to model shard mismatch on some hosts.

raj: Rolling back APAC canary now. `/deploy rollback --slice s-114 --reason "kv_cache_miss spike"`

deploy-bot: :arrows_counterclockwise: Rollback initiated for slice s-114. Pin released.

ops-sre: Confirming APAC traffic back to previous model variant and draining faulty hosts. I'll isolate the hosts and run repro.

maria: Good call. Hold APAC rollout until patch or full isolation validated. We'll pin US/EU stable release and open a follow-up incident. @sara can you create the postmortem ticket?

sara: Yep, creating ticket now and adding triage notes + observability links. Ticket: INC-2026-145.

kevin: I'm investigating root cause — likely KV routing config mismatch on canary subset. Quick hotfix candidate: config sync + restart of affected pool. Will prepare patch.

maria: Thanks everyone. Summary: US/EU rolled, APAC canary rolled back due to kv_cache_miss spike. Holding APAC until remediation. Follow-up actions in INC-2026-145. If anything changes ping here. :thumbsup:
